meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Builds molecular property prediction and MoleculeNet workflows with DeepChem, including SMILES featurization, scaffold or grouped holdouts, masked labels, graph models and explicit pretrained encoder transfer. Used for ADMET, toxicity, solubility and chemistry ML when DeepChem data/model contracts and scientific validation are needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测分子的毒性与溶解度,搭建可复现、可验证的化学建模流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做药物发现或化学建模,需要把分子性质预测做得可复现、可验证。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do drug discovery or chemistry modeling and need reproducible, validated property prediction.

howto.what: 让 Claude 用 DeepChem 处理分子数据:读取 SMILES/SDF 等文件、转成特征、按骨架划分数据集,训练溶解度、毒性等性质预测模型,并在 MoleculeNet 基准上评测或微调预训练模型。
howto.when: 当你提到 SMILES、ADMET、MoleculeNet 等关键词,或要求预测分子性质、训练化学/生物数据模型、把分子转成特征时接管。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude use DeepChem for molecular ML: load SMILES/SDF data, featurize molecules, scaffold-split datasets, train property predictors (solubility, toxicity), run MoleculeNet benchmarks, and fine-tune pretrained models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SMILES, ADMET, or MoleculeNet and ask to predict molecular properties, train chemistry/biology models, or featurize molecules.
